## Problem

What's the actual pain point or limitation you're hitting? Describe the situation, not the solution.

## Proposed solution

What would you like to see? Be specific about user-facing behavior and any new flags / config keys / scripts involved.

## Have you checked the roadmap?

Before opening this issue, please skim [docs/ROADMAP.md](../docs/ROADMAP.md). The candidate list has currently-in-scope ideas; the "Explicit non-goals" section calls out ideas that have been considered and deliberately rejected. If your request is in the non-goals section, please address why the rejection rationale doesn't apply to your case.

- [ ] I've checked `docs/ROADMAP.md` and this request is not already filed or rejected.

## Compatibility / non-negotiables

`holotype` has six non-negotiables documented in `SKILL.md` (forensic completeness, hash chain, git substrate, environment capture, append-only, no silent network). Does your request affect any of them?

- [ ] No — purely additive
- [ ] Yes — see explanation below

(If yes, explain how the request preserves the spirit of the non-negotiable in a different way, or argue why the rule should be revised.)

## Alternatives you've considered

What other approaches did you think about? Why is this one better?

## Are you willing to contribute it?

- [ ] Yes — I'd like to write the PR
- [ ] Maybe — depends on complexity / guidance
- [ ] No — filing for visibility / discussion only

(All three options are fine; the question helps with planning.)
